title: Sin
definition: Sin is any lack of conformity to the character, will, and law of God, whether in thought, desire, word, action, or nature.
summary: Sin is not merely a mistake or weakness; it is rebellion against God and a corruption of the heart. It separates from God, brings guilt, and requires redemption.
christFocus: Christ came to save sinners. At the cross He bore sin’s judgment, and by the Spirit He delivers believers from sin’s dominion.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Sin includes guilt before God and corruption within humanity.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: The answer to sin is not self-improvement but redemption in Christ.
